mark_paid.confirmation: This marks invoice #{invoice_number} as paid. If incorrect, contact Smartout for a credit note. You cannot undo this.

payments.overdue_hint: This invoice is overdue. Quick payment avoids further reminders.
payments.interstitial_heading: Sending you to Stripe for secure payment…
payments.interstitial_description: Payment is handled by Stripe. Smartout never sees your card number.
payments.confirmation_description: Your receipt is in the email from Stripe. The invoice updates automatically.
payments.cancelled_gentle: Payment cancelled. You can try again whenever you like.

payments_admin.page_description: Stripe payments across all workspaces. Refunds are initiated here.
payments_admin.empty_description: Payments appear here when workspaces use "Pay now" or platform-admin generates a payment link.

refund.dialog_description: The refund is executed by Stripe. A credit note is created automatically once the refund is confirmed.
refund.amount_hint: Default: full refund. Set a lower value for partial refund.
refund.reason_detail_placeholder: Briefly describe what happened. This is logged in activity trail, not in Stripe.
refund.irreversible_warning: Refunds are irreversible in Stripe after 90 days. Money returns to the card the customer used.
refund.success_toast: Refund initiated. Update will arrive via Stripe webhook.
